// Chokepoint fixture (plugin-assets, PLUG-02): a module that finds a shipped
// asset with its own package.json walk and names the asset directory itself —
// as a path.join segment, in a template literal and by string concatenation.
// The plugin bundle and a Claude Code plugin-cache copy hold no package.json,
// so this reads the wrong folder there — the rule must flag every form and
// point at paths.ts pluginReferencePath() / pluginTemplatePath().
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

export function sneakyReference(pkgRoot: string): string {
  return readFileSync(path.join(pkgRoot, 'references', 'http-warnings.md'), 'utf8');
}

export function sneakyTemplate(root: string): string {
  return readFileSync(`${root}/plugin/references/honesty-framing.md`, 'utf8');
}

export function sneakyPreset(root: string): string {
  return readFileSync(root + '/plugin/templates/presets/disciplines.json', 'utf8');
}
